headline_fact: The US economy unexpectedly shed 23,000 jobs in July 2026 (nonfarm payrolls), versus forecasts of an 80,000 gain, with the unemployment rate at 4.1%; May and June figures were also revised down by a combined 103,000 jobs. Released August 7, 2026 by the Bureau of Labor Statistics.
narration_script: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, in July 2026, the US economy unexpectedly lost 23,000 jobs in nonfarm payrolls compared to forecasts of an increase.
